# Casa Jannat · Jaco Escape
> Four-bedroom private-pool vacation rental in Jacó, Costa Rica. Operated by Jaco Escape. Book on Airbnb; direct booking coming soon.

Casa Jannat is an entire home in Jacó, Puntarenas, Costa Rica. It sleeps up to 8 guests across 4 bedrooms (1 king, 3 queens) plus a sofa bed, with a private pool and spa, self check-in via lockbox, and walking distance to Jacó beach. Public Airbnb rating: 4.9 from 49 stays.

## Key facts
- Property: Casa Jannat (entire home)
- Operator: Jaco Escape
- Location: Jacó, Puntarenas, Costa Rica (neighborhood pin; street address after confirmation)
- Guests: up to 8
- Bedrooms: 4 (king + 3 queens); sofa bed in living room
- Bathrooms: 3 (including pool-side)
- Pool: private pool and round spa
- Check-in: 15:00 lockbox · Checkout: 11:00
- Quiet hours: 22:00–08:00 · No glass at the pool
- Reviews: 4.9 / 5 from 49 Airbnb stays
